getting_started.title: Start Hear
getting_started.intro: A liddle tour ov da admin and da furst stuffz 2 set up.
getting_started.q_tour: Wut iz in da admin sidebar?
getting_started.a_tour: Da sidebar puts evrythin in MAH CREASHUNS (yer postz n stuffz), MAH FANZ (testimonialz, commentz, peepz), n Settingz (accownt, site, integrayshunz). Plus pinnd linkz 4 Dashbord, Homepaj, Media Library, n Facets. Click a heder 2 fold or unfold it. Da plus button on MAH CREASHUNS n MAH FANZ open a quick mak menu. So eezy!
getting_started.q_profile: How I set up mah profile?
getting_started.a_profile: Open da Homepaj editr n unfold Profile and Contact. Put in yer name, headline, summary, n linkz. Diz feedz da public homepaj hero n da default Facet layout. Yu can changez wenevr.
getting_started.q_preview: How I peek at mah public site?
getting_started.a_preview: Click da site name in da top bar, or open da root URL in anothr tab. Changez show up rite away aftr u save — no separate publish step 4 most stuffz.
getting_started.q_encryption: Wut iz dis encryption key warning?
getting_started.a_encryption: Facet maeks an encryption key at /data/.encryption_key on furst start. Dis key keepz API tokenz n share linkz safe in da databaze. U loze da key file = u no can decrypt dat stuffz. Put /data in yer backupz. SRSLY DO IT.

homepage.title: Buildin yer Homepaj
homepage.intro: Brand, hero, nav, section ordr, n visibility — all in won editr. Eezy peezy!
homepage.q_brand: Wear I set mah brand colorz n fontz?
homepage.a_brand: Open da Homepaj editr n unfold da Brand section. Pik a accent color, choze a font pak, n tweek spasin or typografy. Brand changez go on evry public paje.
homepage.a_hero: Unfold da Hero Section. Pik a layout, set da big text n smaller text, ad a call 2 acshun button, n choze a backgrownd pic or vidyo. Da layout pikkr letz u peek b4 yu save.
homepage.a_nav: Unfold Site Navigation 2 pik which Facets show up in da public top bar. Drag 2 reordr, rename labelz, n flip between automatik (all visibul Facets) n manual mode.
homepage.q_sections: How I reordr da homepaj sectionz?
homepage.a_sections: Unfold Section Ordr. Drag da handelz 2 reordr, toggl sectionz on or off, n pik widthz 4 sectionz dat alow it. Ordr applyz 2 both deztop n mobil.
homepage.q_visibility: Can I hide da WHOLE homepaj?
homepage.a_visibility: Yaz u can! Unfold Visibility 2 mark da homepaj Public, Unlistd, or Privat. Privat needz a share tokn; Unlistd workz by URL but not in indexing or listingz.

facets.title: Makin Facets
facets.intro: Facets r audyenz-shapd viewz of yer stuffz, each wit ownz URL n section list.
facets.a_what: A Facet iz a custumized vershun ov yer site — diffrnt sectionz, diffrnt layout, or a hand-pikkd set ov yer stuffz — at its own URL path. Liek won Facet 4 recruiterz n anothr 4 clients. Many options!
facets.a_create: From da Facets list, clik New Facet. Giv it a name n a slug, den uze da section managr 2 choze wut shoz n in wut ordr. Yu can also ovrride accent color n font pak per Facet.
facets.q_search: R thar keyboard shortcuts on da Facets list?
facets.a_search: OH YAH. Press / 2 fokuz da search box, j n k 2 mooove between rowz, Enter 2 open a Facet, n ? 2 see da fulll keyboard halp. Filter chipz at da top narrow by visibility, share linkz, nav membership, or inactiv state.
facets.q_overrides: Can each Facet ovrride da homepaj stuffz?
facets.a_overrides: Yaz. In a Facet editr u can ovrride accent color, font pak, hero, n section ordr witowt changin da homepaj or othr Facets. Wutevr u dont ovrride falls bak 2 homepaj defaultz.
facets.q_visibility: Wut visibility opshunz do Facets do?
facets.a_visibility: Public (anyone canz find), Unlistd (anyone wit URL), Password (needz shared wurd), n Privat (only via share tokn u maekd). Share toknz r managd inside each Facet.

content.title: Postz n Stuffz
content.intro: Postz, projektz, talkz, custum stuffz, n da media library all share da same editr n shortcodez.
content.a_editor: Da editr takez markdown wit liv preview. Bold, headingz, listz, linkz, code blokz, tabelz, n quotez all work. Uze da toolbar or jus typ markdown direktly. Draftz save themselvz wile u typ. So convenent!
content.a_shortcodes: Inside postz n othr markdown u canz embedz media wit shortcodez liek {{youtube:URL}}, {{vimeo:URL}}, {{loom:URL}}, {{spotify:URL}}, {{soundcloud:URL}}, {{codepen:URL}}, {{figma:URL}}, {{pdf:URL}}, {{video:URL}}, n {{image:URL}}. Past da full URL — Facet doez da embedz.
content.a_media: Open Media Library from da sidebar. Drag filez in 2 upload, den attach 2 postz, projektz, hero backgrowndz, or anywear wit a file pikkr. Edit alt text n captshun rite thar — alt text iz REQUIRD 4 new picz so da public site stayz reachabl 2 evryone.
content.a_drafts: Postz, talkz, n custum stuffz all hav a draft togl. Draftz r hidden frum da public site. Da Content sidebar shoz a draft count badj so u finds unfinishd stuffz fast.
content.q_tags: Wut iz da diffrenz between admin tagz n public tagz?
content.a_tags: Public tagz show on da public site n let visitorz filtr stuffz. Admin tagz r privat labelz 4 yer own organizin — neva shown publicly. Manaj admin tagz undr Settingz den Admin Tagz.

ai.title: AI Halpr
ai.intro: Self-hostd Facet usez YER own AI provider keyz. Nothin goez thru a Facet-runnd servis.
ai.q_byo: How AI work on self-hostd Facet?
ai.a_byo: AI halp iz bring-yer-own-key ONLY. U ad a API key 4 OpenAI, 4 Anthropic, or 4 a local Ollama, n Facet callz dose providerz direktly wit yer credenshulz. Thar iz no managd creditz n no monthly tokn quotaz — yer provider billz u direktly.
ai.a_providers: OpenAI (GPT modelz), Anthropic (Claude modelz), Ollama (eny model u haz pulld localy), n a generik OpenAI-compatibul Custum opshun 4 self-hostd gatewayz or othr compatibul APIz. U can sett many providerz n pik a default.
ai.q_usage: Wut AI halps wit inside Facet?
ai.a_usage: Rewritin postz, polishin bios n summaryz, suggestin tagz, halpin wit importz frum LinkedIn or pastd rezumez, n maekin alt text 4 picz. AI featurez only show up aftr u sett at least won provider.
ai.q_local: Can I keep evrythin on mah own machine wit Ollama?
ai.a_local: YAZ. Install Ollama, pull a model liek llama3.2 or mistral, den in da integrayshunz paje ad a Ollama provider wit da baze URL of yer Ollama servr. No data leevz yer network. Yu winz!

settings.title: Settingz n Stuffz
settings.intro: Site lookz, emaylz, n operashunal stuffz liv undr da Settingz group in da sidebar.
settings.q_appearance: How I change da favicon, custum CSS, or default theem?
settings.a_appearance: Open Site Settingz. U canz upload a favicon, past custum CSS dat applyz 2 evry public paje, n pik da default theem mode (system, light, or dark) dat new visitorz see b4 thay choze.
settings.q_language: How I sett da site languaj?
settings.a_language: Site languaj iz sett in Site Settingz undr da General area. Diz controlz da languaj of da public site. Da admin panel followz da same choze.
settings.a_smtp: Site Settingz haz a SMTP configgr section. Put in yer host, port, usernaem, password, n frum-addrez, den uze Send Test Emayl 2 chek it work. SMTP iz neeedd 4 testimonial verificashunz, subscriber confirmz, n admin notificashunz.
settings.q_backups: How I back up mah data?
settings.a_backups: Open About Facet 2 manaj nativ PocketBase backupz. U canz mak a backup on demand, see da list of egzistin backupz, n restore frum won. Backupz r writtd 2 /data/backups inside da container — put /data in yer host-side backup routine.
settings.a_audit: Da Audit Log undr Settingz records administrativ acshunz liek loginz, content editz, n setting changez. Uze it 2 review activity or troublshootz.
